correctness.rationale: Exact conversion to unordered size-multiplicity pairs; D(Y)=Y log Y+(2γ-1)Y+O(sqrt Y) permits replacement by density log y+2γ with cumulative convolution error O_k(X^(k-1/2)log^(k-1)X). Dirichlet simplex has E log u=-H_k and E log u1 log u2=H_k²+H_k^(2)-ζ(2). Two-index size equality yields ζ(2) X²/2+O(X log X) and hence ζ(2)X^k log^(k-2)X/k!. Higher collision intersections are O_k(X^k log^(k-3)X). Explicit k=2 boundary error O(X^(3/2)log X). The included independent finite verifier returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The count of integer partitions with fixed number of occupied sizes is a natural partition statistic. Its first two logarithmic orders cannot distinguish a symmetrized divisor-tuple count from genuine partitions; the theorem identifies exactly where size collisions become visible and computes the ζ(2)-controlled correction for every fixed k, with a power-saving completion at k=2. This answers a motivated structural asymptotic question, not an arbitrary slice or table recomputation.
